fusions.name: Sticky Tongue
fusions.desc: Flicks a tongue at the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 water damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds, with 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Sudden Spring
fusions.desc: A spring onto a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 28 water damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It always crits.

fusions.name: Not Here Now
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Lily-Pad Gait

riders.text: you cross it faster than you cross ground
and you are harder to catch while you cross

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster over it, from silver your dodge chance rises by 6%, and from gold your stamina recovers 15% faster.
